notes.text: Available in cPanel 98 and later. Supply an Account Enhancement identifier; WHM list_account_enhancements lists the server identifiers.

The integer data result is 1 when the enhancement is assigned and 0 when it is not assigned. This is separate from the UAPI status: an unsuccessful UAPI envelope or outer WHM envelope still fails the call.
